subject: ALTERNATE RECORD KEY clause
notes: LANDED 2026-10-05 (kb/Work PB1073). RULE (--check 12.4.5.6.3 3): "Data-name-1 and data-name-2 shall not reference a variable-length data item." §8.5.1.11.1: a variable-length data item is "a dynamic-capacity table or a dynamic-length elementary item". FileControlKeyRules.Rules (AlternateRecordKey role) asks the key operand's IsDynamicLength attribute (COBOL0863). The dynamic-capacity-table arm is a key under OCCURS and SR1's row reports it (a dynamic-capacity table cannot be in a record at all, COBOL1526), so the row does not say the same fact twice; a GROUP containing a dynamic-length item is a variable-length GROUP, which the standard names separately where it means to forbid one (§12.4.5.8.3 SR3, §13.10.3 SR12) and does not name here, so it is accepted (the minimum-record-size rule, SR5, bounds it). Re-measured before the fix: probe sr3.cob compiled exit 0 and WRITE returned '00'.
